fields.summary_ko.0: Philippe Laffont of Coatue Management initiated a new position in SK Hynix (SKHY) during Q3, betting on its pricing power as an AI memory leader and multi-year supply visibility.
fields.summary_ko.1: SK Hynix achieved Q3 revenue of KRW 104.62 trillion (328% increase year-over-year), crossing KRW 100 trillion for the first time, operating profit of KRW 83.33 trillion (exceeding LSEG Smart Estimates of KRW 76.7 trillion), and net income of KRW 39.78 trillion.
fields.summary_ko.2: SK Hynix stock has risen over 100% from early 2026, though it has declined significantly from its June peak, supported by long-term performance driven by AI infrastructure investment and memory price increases.
